title: Metaphoric Evolution, Linguistic Innovation, and the Global Horizon

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian has survived through centuries by assimilating foreign concepts and reclothing them in native metaphorical garb. Just as the 19th-century *nyelvújítás* created thousands of enduring words, today the digital world undergoes natural metaphoric extension (*metaforikus kiterjesztés*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The internet is not a foreign territory; it is conceived through native directional cases (*a neten, a hálóra, a felhőbe*), proving that Hungarian remains a dynamic, living organism (*élő szervezet*).
